# Chemnotia

> Laboratory glassware and bench consumables, supplied from a stockroom in Leuven, Flemish Brabant, Belgium, and quoted by email against a part list.

Chemnotia stocks borosilicate beakers, conical and volumetric flasks, measuring cylinders, funnels and watch glasses; wash bottles, tubing, stoppers, filter paper and disposable pipettes; and racks, retort stands, clamps and boss heads. Capacities and tolerance classes are quoted exactly as the maker prints them. The business supplies no reagents, solvents or chemicals, issues no calibration certificate, claims no certification, and sells nothing for medical, diagnostic, clinical or veterinary use. It does not repair or anneal glassware, and it does not judge whether an assembly or a method is safe for anyone's work.

## Pages

- [Home](https://chemnotia.com/): scope, the six families, how an order runs, questions, contact lines
- [Glassware](https://chemnotia.com/glassware.html): beakers, flasks, cylinders, funnels by capacity and class; how a tolerance class is read
- [Bench consumables](https://chemnotia.com/bench-consumables.html): wash bottles, tubing by bore and wall, stoppers by size, filter paper by grade, pipettes
- [Racks and stands](https://chemnotia.com/racks-and-stands.html): racks by tube diameter, stands by rod and base, clamps, boss heads, loading a stand
- [Request a price list](https://chemnotia.com/request-a-price-list.html): the form that takes a part list
- [Privacy notice](https://chemnotia.com/privacy.html)
- [Terms of use](https://chemnotia.com/terms.html)
